historical_acceptance_policy: Explicit automaticRecovery=false retains policy 1.1.0; no user-facing legacy setting.

recovery.observation_failure_streak_reset: A successful current observation with valid geometry.
recovery.gui_requests: Fresh observation and new counted GUI attempt; never replay a phone action or enable HTTP implicit retries.
recovery.observations: Bounded independent retry allowance; no model step charged before a model attempt is started.
recovery.tls_handshake_failure: May be a transient connection interruption. Try a fresh counted request within the same finite limit, keeping platform certificate and hostname verification unchanged.
recovery.invalid_gui_output: Discard the invalid reply and request a new decision; no tool, argument or coordinate correction.
recovery.temporary_observation: SCREENSHOT_FAILED, or AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE with fixed SCREENSHOT_UNAVAILABLE reason; control, authorization, locked-device, protected-input and uncertain-input boundaries remain enforced.

planner.already_sent_failure: Keep existing fallback rule; never repair or resend that ordinal.
planner.not_yet_sent_observation_failure: Bounded fresh observation before the same unsent ordinal, never charge or fabricate a call.
planner.second_planner_finish: Ends directly, without another GUI request.

control.takeover_or_stop: Invalidate and cancel recovery delay before further observation or dispatch.
control.manual: No automatic capture, model request or input.
control.input_terminal_unknown: End request must retain the native input barrier; never continue model execution past unknown input.
control.harness_off: Same recovery policy, original task and own history; no Planner, stage-history switch or remaining-objective injection.

termination.persistent_or_hard_failure: runtime_failure with completion_source=none and original categorized error; never task success or a fabricated model unable.
termination.gui_budget_exhausted: budget_exhausted, without a free repair/finish or extra Planner entry.
termination.audit_failure: Fail closed, end interrupted after genuine native input terminals; no unlogged continuation.

data.minimal_event_schema: 1.3.0 for new automatic-recovery sessions; historical sessions keep their schema.
data.screenshots: Necessary frames in RAM only; no history, file, export or manual-period capture.
data.credentials: Existing encrypted local profile store; no key in source, logs or exports.
